source.title: [VNC AI CEO] Integrate one executive control center with existing Agent OS (MVP)
source.body:
## Objective
Deliver **one** CEO-facing VNC AI control surface by extending existing `/admin/automation`, not creating a second Agent OS. VNC OS remains source of truth. Business is exclusively international B2B apparel/merchandise sourcing/OEM (no retail, D2C, licensing or artist management).

## Dependencies and reuse
- Reuse merged PR #187 (AgentRun/TaskRun/AgentEvent/AgentDecision persistence) and #211 (exact-head review/watchdog).
- PR #219 (continuous autonomous engineering loop) remains open as of 2026-10-22; independently verify and complete it, don't duplicate its orchestration.
- Align draft architecture PR #227 and strategy PR #226; review first, do not blindly merge.
- Existing authenticated lead bridge from #225 is an API primitive, not proof that web→CRM works live.

## Minimum CEO experience (MVP)
1. One page within `/admin/automation`: **Today**, **In progress**, **Needs approval**, **Blocked**, **Completed**, and one task input.
2. CEO issues business outcome; AI coordinator creates a durable work plan with accountable agent, dependencies, due dates, acceptance criteria and evidence per task.
3. Add Sales and Sourcing manager role capabilities first, with a real RFQ -> CRM -> supplier feasibility -> draft quotation workflow. Existing Technology/CTO agent remains the engineering runtime, not replaced.
4. Approval policy: automatic internal read/classify/draft; human gates for outbound quote/send, customer commitments, payments, production deployment and destructive operations.
5. One trace/audit timeline and status per work item, retries idempotent and bounded; detect stalled work and surface next action.
6. CEO digest with verified outcomes and unresolved blockers, with no fictitious activity or progress.

## Technical acceptance
- Inspect actual existing schema, routes, auth, dashboard and job orchestration before coding.
- Database migration additive, rollback safe, no independent task/status shadow store.
- Unit + integration tests including duplicate RFQ intake, dependency blocking, approval gate bypass prevention, stuck job recovery and replay safety.
- Preview/staging E2E desktop + mobile 393x852.
- No change to vietnamclothing.vn, os.vietnamclothing.vn production, domain, secrets, production DB or live flows without validation and explicit approval.

## Deliverables
- Gap analysis mapped to code + PR #219 / #227.
- Implementation PR(s), green CI, preview demo, QA report, final checklist.
- Separate status: implemented in code / staging verified / production verified.
- Prioritize shortest useful vertical slice; don't build all 8 agents before a working RFQ process.

## Done when
From ONE CEO interface, test lead creates ONE CRM record and actionable RFQ task; Sales and Sourcing each provide evidenced output, AI coordinator produces human-approvable draft quote; CEO sees actual statuses, blockers and approval gates. No customer communication or production changes occur without authorization.

CTO OWNERSHIP CONSOLIDATION — 2026-10-22

Effective immediately, VNC technology has one accountable owner: **VNC CTO**.

Canonical sources:
- VNC OS / Agent OS / AI CEO Control Center: `hoangthang1209-byte/vnc-os`
- VNC Website: `hoangthang1209-byte/vietnam-clothing-v2`

No Digital Product Manager workstream or parallel technology backlog will be maintained.

Execution mapping:
1. P0 Agent OS Core -> Issue #218 / PR #219.
2. P0 AI CEO Control Center + Management Team integration -> this Issue #229; PR #227 is specification input; draft PR #228 is implementation foundation.
3. P0 RFQ -> CRM -> Costing -> Quotation -> Sales/Sourcing agent vertical slice -> part of this Issue #229 using existing CRM/Pricing/Quote data, with #212/#213 treated as supporting audit specs rather than separate owners.
4. P1 VNC Website -> Website repo draft PR #1 is the canonical active implementation; production vietnamclothing.vn remains untouched until exact-head staging QA passes.
5. P1 VNC OS UX/UI -> reuse existing admin UX issues (#216 and scoped surviving work from #171); do not duplicate navigation/costing redesign tasks.
6. QA is owned by CTO and executed per PR; #217 remains reusable regression/smoke specification, not a separate product-management lane.

Status labels and PR merge state are not accepted as proof of production. Production requires exact deployment SHA + smoke evidence.
